decision_clock: Closed 1H decisions; only complete contiguous UTC-aligned 4H and 12H candles are eligible.

engines.analyst_stack_v2: 4H primary thesis; 12H/1D opposition veto; 1H resumption trigger; BTC-first alt veto; 1.5ATR extension and RSI 80/20 blowoff veto
engines.momentum_12h_probe: diagnostic only: continue the last 12H move when it exceeded 0.35 current 1H ATR
engines.momentum_4h_probe: diagnostic only: continue the last 4H move when it exceeded 0.35 current 1H ATR
engines.reversal_12h_probe: diagnostic only: fade the last 12H move when it exceeded 0.35 current 1H ATR
engines.reversal_4h_probe: diagnostic only: fade the last 4H move when it exceeded 0.35 current 1H ATR

label_policy: future close move vs current close; WAIT when abs(move)<=0.35*current 1H ATR
